half_move.rules: May perform another non-movement Half Action at -20 penalty.
half_move.citation: “Half Moving takes a Half Action… another non-movement Half Action at -20 Penalty.”

full_move.rules: May perform another non-movement action at -20 penalty.
full_move.citation: “A Full Move takes a Full Action… another non-movement Half or Full Action at -20 Penalty.”

charge.rules: May perform non-movement, non-melee Half Action at -30 penalty.
charge.citation: “A Charge takes a Full Action… non-Movement and non-Melee Half Action at -30 Penalty.”

run.rules: May perform non-movement Half Action at -40 penalty.
run.citation: “A Run takes a Full Action… non-movement Half Action at -40 Penalty.”

sprint.rules: Cannot perform any other actions; requires Blur Ability.
sprint.citation: “Sprint… can only be taken using the Blur Ability.”
